name: Color Blox
desc:
👋Welcome to Color Blox - minigames bursting with color!🌈

⭐Earn coins and unlock adorable pets, cool trails and awesome gear!🐱

✨This game is the most fun to play with friends! Be sure to invite people to play with you!😃

🎁Join the Parwaz Studios group for a free pet in-game!🎁

🎮Current minigames: Color Block, Last One's Out, Four Platforms🎮

✨This game has a colorblind mode you can toggle on/off in the settings menu!✨

Tags: color, color blox, color block, four corners, last ones out, minigames, fun
